verdict.rationale: Okta offers a free Integrator/developer org signup explicitly for testing code and apps without touching production, plus a dedicated XAA dev playground with no local setup, which supports sandbox-style testing for agentic/AI workflows. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm data isolation guarantees or a full 'sandbox environment' concept distinct from a free trial org. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a dedicated sandbox/staging environment separate from production tenants, and independent confirmation that test orgs fully isolate data from production use.
